metadata.name: Token
metadata.description: Use this API to either generate token or refresh token to access CoreCard APIs.

request_fields.name: UserID
request_fields.description: User ID provided by CoreCARD to login in CoreCard System. Condition: mandatory when GrantType = AccessToken. Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: Password
request_fields.description: Password of user id Condition: mandatory when GrantType = AccessToken. Allowable Values: 32

request_fields.name: GrantType
request_fields.description: Grant Type. Valid values : 'AccessToken', and 'RefreshToken'. Allowable Values: 32

request_fields.name: RefreshToken
request_fields.description: use this to re generate Access Token Condition:Mandatory when GrantType = RefreshToken.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: access_token
response_fields.description: This tag reflects Access Token which is used to access CoreCard API's.

response_fields.name: expires_in
response_fields.description: This tag reflects the Expires. It is the time when provided Access Token has been expired.

response_fields.name: refresh_token
response_fields.description: This tag reflects Refresh Token. It is used to re generate Access Token when the GrantType value is RefreshToken.

response_fields.name: issued
response_fields.description: This tag reflects the IssuedAt. It is the time when token provided to access CoreCard API.

response_fields.name: userName
response_fields.description: This Tag reflects User ID provided by CoreCARD to login in CoreCard System.

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: expires
children.description: Time when provided Access Token will be expired.

children.name: RefreshToken
children.description: Use Refresh Token to re generate Access Token with GrantType as RefreshToken.

children.name: TokenType
children.description: Type of token. Valid Value : Bearer

children.name: UserID
children.description: User ID provided by CoreCARD to login in CoreCard System.

children.name: IssuedAt
children.description: Time when token provided to access CoreCard API.
